newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African mother sells 12-year-old for $45, police.
newsitem.headline: S.African mother sells 12-year-old for $45, police.

text.p: A 12-year-old South African girl was sold by her mother for 200 rand ($45) to marry a Jordanian man, police said on Thursday.
"Investigations thus far reveal that the mother received about 200 rand for her daughter's hand and jewellery as part of the dowry," spokesman Mark Reynolds said.
He said police found the child after a tip-off last Friday in a hotel with her 18-year-old husband, whom she had married the day before in a mosque.
Police have taken the girl away from her Catholic mother and father, who consented to the marriage. She is being kept in care.
South African law prohibits children younger than 15 getting married. Reynolds said no arrests had been made.
